scope: End-to-end verification of live 2026-10-23 Hotspawn CS2 inventory (92 scheduled API rows, 30 active upcoming fixtures), all 9 model-tier fixtures against HLTV match pages + Polymarket Gamma + Bovada + Pinnacle + Valve 2026-10-05 global standings + bo3.gg, 17 competition-scoped alias joins in data/origination/aliases.json, deterministic 2026-10-15 replay fixtures, and mobile executive-summary / row-source HTML audits.
